source: llama-cpp-turboquant-experts-laguna (fork of ggml-org/llama.cpp + TheTom/llama-cpp-turboquant + leoustc/llama.cpp-moe + deepseek-v4 + Laguna)
purpose: Machine-readable catalogue of every tunable parameter the LlamaDock GUI should expose. The frontend renders groups/params from this file; the core maps each param's 'flags' to a llama-server argument. Add future flags (e.g. --spec-type draft-dspark) as one new row + a flags template - no engine rewrite needed.

param_fields.id: unique key; also used in per-model memory (config/models-config.json) and memory-presets overrides
param_fields.allow_custom: true => free-text/int allowed beyond the pick list
param_fields.flag_value: optional template rendering the value into the flag
param_fields.advanced: true => hidden behind an Advanced disclosure
param_fields.help: plain-language explanation shown in the UI

params.label: Runtime engine
params.help: Which llama.cpp fork launches the model. Auto infers from model name (TQ3->TurboTan, Ternary/Bonsai->PrismBonsai, Laguna/Expert->ExpertsLaguna, etc.).

params.label: Workflow preset
params.help: Workflow target: chooses the client workspace and sensible defaults for many parameters below.

params.label: Deep research depth
params.help: Used by LlamaAgentResearch / DeepResearch workspaces.

params.label: Context window
params.help: Context (KV) size in tokens. Larger uses more RAM/VRAM; RAM overrun is blocked before launch.

params.label: Prompt cache RAM (MiB)
params.help: --cache-ram: RAM reserved for the prompt/KV cache. Lower = lighter on RAM.

params.label: GPU offload mode
params.help: Prompt = ask; Auto = fit to VRAM; All = all GPU; CPU = none GPU; Custom = use gpu_layers.

params.label: GPU layers (-ngl)
params.help: Transformer layers offloaded to GPU. Core knob for the CPU/GPU split.

params.label: KV cache type K
params.help: Key cache quantization. Lower (q4/q8) = lighter; higher (f16/bf16) = quality/VRAM.

params.label: KV cache type V
params.help: Value cache quantization. Asymmetric KV (K=q8_0, V=q4_0) is a common light-memory profile.

params.label: Flash attention
params.help: Faster attention, lower memory. ROCm may crash on SWA layers - set off if that happens.

params.label: CPU threads
params.help: Threads for generation/backfill.

params.label: CPU threads (batch)
params.help: Threads for prompt processing/batching.

params.label: Expert placement
params.help: all-gpu = every expert on GPU; frequency = keep frequently-picked ('hot') experts on GPU and the rest on CPU (great for light memory); cpu-moe = all experts on CPU; map = use expert_map.json.

params.label: GPU expert ratio (hot ratio)
params.help: For 'frequency' placement: ratio of experts held 'hot' on the GPU. 0.2-0.5 is a conservative light-memory start.

params.label: GPU expert slots
params.help: GPU-resident MoE expert slots for router-aware expert paging (-1 = disabled; 0 = active_expert_count).

params.label: Keep all MoE on CPU
params.help: Keep every MoE weight in CPU (aggressive saving for large MoE models).

params.label: CPU MoE layers (--n-cpu-moe)
params.help: Number of MoE layers kept in CPU. Higher = lighter GPU/VRAM.

params.label: Active experts count
params.help: llama.expert_used_count override. 2 is a common fast MoE setting; try 3 after a clean boot.

params.label: Expert map path
params.help: Path to expert_map.json for explicit 'map' placement.

params.label: Spec type

allowed.label: DSpark (future; DeepSeek V4 Flash/Pro DSpark checkpoints)

params.help: Speculative decoding mode. MTP uses the model's built-in MTP head (combined *_MTP.gguf). DSpark is a planned draft mode from DeepSeek (DeepSpec) - add the fork flag when available.

params.label: Draft model path
params.help: Path to the draft model (simple/eagle3). Blank = auto-discover an MTP head next to the -hf model.

params.label: Draft GPU layers
params.help: GPU layers for the draft model.

params.label: Draft KV cache type K
params.help: Key cache type for the draft model.

params.label: Draft KV cache type V
params.help: Value cache type for the draft model.

params.label: Draft max candidates
params.help: Max draft tokens accepted per step.

params.label: Draft min candidates
params.help: Min draft tokens accepted per step.

params.label: Draft threads
params.help: Threads for the draft model.

params.label: Draft P split
params.help: Draft-model acceptance split probability.

params.label: Draft P min
params.help: Draft-model minimum acceptance probability.

params.label: Draft backend sampling
params.help: Sample in the draft backend instead of host.

params.label: Keep draft MoE on CPU
params.help: Keep the draft model's MoE weights in CPU.

params.label: Draft CPU MoE layers
params.help: Number of draft MoE layers kept in CPU.

params.label: Reasoning mode
params.help: Thinking/reasoning enablement. off = fastest for interactive work; on = full reasoning.

params.label: KV overrides
params.help: Additional --override-kv entries (newline/comma separated). e.g. llama.expert_used_count=int:2

params.label: Chat template kwargs (JSON)
params.help: JSON passed to the chat template (e.g. {"enable_thinking":false}).

params.label: Server tools (WebUI)
params.help: --tools all enables tool calling for the Open WebUI / Computer workspace.

params.label: MCP mode
params.help: Whether to attach MCP helper servers for this run.

params.label: Frequency penalty
params.help: Repeat alpha frequency penalty (0.0 = disabled).

params.label: Temperature
params.help: Server-side default sampling temperature.

params.label: Seed
params.help: Sampling seed (-1 = random).

params.label: Top-p
params.help: Nucleus sampling.

params.label: Top-k
params.help: Top-k sampling.
